title: Day 28: Pre-Listing Inspections for Sellers – Control the Narrative
excerpt: A seller-ordered inspection identifies issues early, allows repairs on the seller’s timeline, and provides a report that can be shared (or summarized) with buyers.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “should seller get inspection before listing”, “pre listing inspection Austin cost”, and “fix issues before selling Texas” want a local, practical answer.

A seller-ordered inspection identifies issues early, allows repairs on the seller’s timeline, and provides a report that can be shared (or summarized) with buyers. This reduces surprise negotiation leverage later and shortens the option period friction.

Budget for the inspection and any high-priority fixes. Transparency builds trust and often supports a stronger list price.

If you are weighing a list date, a price, or a repair list, The Banks Group will run the numbers for your street and help you decide. Start with a complimentary conversation.
